root_cause: The publication-authority SECURITY DEFINER functions intentionally lock search_path to public,pg_catalog, but called pgcrypto digest() and gen_random_bytes() without schema qualification. In this Supabase project pgcrypto lives in extensions, so capability issuance failed after the pre-publish gate and atomic dispatch claim.
prevention: Schema-qualify pgcrypto calls as extensions.digest and extensions.gen_random_bytes inside locked-search-path SECURITY DEFINER functions.
Do not widen SECURITY DEFINER search_path to recover extension lookup.
Regression-test that no unqualified digest/gen_random_bytes calls exist in the authority migration.
Preserve winner lineage, exact-media proof and dispatching-state authority checks unchanged.
